name: Wanakorosu
source:
10 people of different ages wake up in an unfamiliar house in the middle of a death game!

How did they get here? Why do they have to kill each other? And most importantly: why can't they leave this place?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Wanakorosu/722198]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
10个不同年龄的人在一个陌生的房子里醒来，陷入一场死亡游戏！

他们是怎么来到这里的？为什么他们必须互相残杀？最重要的是：他们为什么不能离开这个地方？

[来自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Wanakorosu/722198]GameJolt[/url]]
